type: post-hoc numerical correction, descriptive reference rows only
finding: label_hist predictions are means of discrete values; float64 summation order leaves mathematically tied values one ULP apart, so roc_auc_score breaks those ties arbitrarily. Rounding to 1e-12 restores the ties. test_results.csv and test_contrasts.csv are left unchanged; tie-aware values are in posthoc_label_hist_tie_aware.csv. No candidate, primary decision or Table-5 row is affected (their predictions have no such near-ties).
verifier_note: the first independent-verification run parsed CSVs with pandas default float parser and did not clip label_hist; both fixed before the second run
